# biomes/outlands: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

The Outlands (PLAN.md): the walled basin beyond the Outer Wall, its native flora colonial (the Outlands only: a buried mycelium raises three or four forms by role; colonies wall each other off along seams). Seven pages (PLAN.md section 9): station 1, the Fog Wall (dist/outlands.html: the fog belt to the gem shoulder, veil, mast, copper and wadi colonies); and on stations/_shared's host, each on the 5.1 model's ground for its site, 2 the River (mast and river colonies, the Valley tribe's fields, the 705 m lake), 3 the Gem Hills (copper, wadi, steppe; the emerald and turquoise workings, KSTACKS fins), 4 the Plains of Runners (the steppe's mosaic, inselbergs and tors, a salt pan's brine), 5 the Nursery Bench (nursery colonies on desert pavement, the yardangs), 7 Trickster's House (Arcoindian II read in place from kits/ancients, the aware House colony on it), 8 the Mires (string bog, flark pools, palsas on KFROST). The colony pass: src/48-outl-colony.js (OUTLCOL; tests/test-colony.js), the forms by role 60 and 62, every form on BIO.fung. Verified: build.py, verify.py --assert (stations 2-8 in software GL only: the GPU verify is owed). Read BIOME-API.md

Docs: `BIOME-API.md`, `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `PLAN.md`, `PORT.md`, `SURVEY.md`

Built output (never open it; edit `src/` and rebuild): `dist/outlands-gems.html`, `dist/outlands-house.html`, `dist/outlands-mires.html`, `dist/outlands-nursery.html`, `dist/outlands-plains.html`, `dist/outlands-river.html`, `dist/outlands.html`

Build: `cd biomes/outlands && python3 build.py`. Fragments are concatenated in filename order.
